Bacterial spot.treatment: Remove affected leaves and apply a labeled copper-based bactericide.

Early blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves and apply a labeled fungicide such as mancozeb.

Healthy.treatment: The plant appears healthy. Continue regular watering, nutrition, and monitor.

Late blight.treatment: Remove severely affected plants and apply a labeled fungicide promptly.

Leaf Mold.treatment: Improve ventilation and apply a labeled fungicide if symptoms continue.

Septoria leaf spot.treatment: Remove infected lower leaves and apply a labeled fungicide.

Spider mites.treatment: Use an approved miticide and isolate heavily infested plants.

Target Spot.treatment: Remove affected foliage and apply a labeled fungicide.

Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.treatment: Remove severely infected plants and control whiteflies with a labeled insecticide.
Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.organic: Yellow sticky traps + remove infected plants

Mosaic virus.treatment: There is no cure; remove and destroy infected plants and disinfect tools.
